about: Which hardware Maker Connect works with, and how each claim is proved. Checked by scripts/hardware-page.py, which also writes the wiki page Hardware; maker-connect.xyz/hardware reads this file from GitHub. Statuses: verified (date, commit, what was done), same-driver (the reference's own source treats it the same; not tested), audit (an audit with result identical, waiting for hardware), planned (an issue).

rows.via: Its own firmware (Buddy 8.0.2), Prusa Connect protocol

proof.how: moving and heating (2026-11-21); files sent from the hub's Files page to its USB stick, and a file already on the stick left alone (#212)

rows.note: Full Buddy support is not finished (#87).

proof.how: a 20 mm test cube (dry-cube-20mm.gcode) run from the hub, with progress and time left on the printer's screen

rows.note: The printer's own SD card is not supported yet (#84).

rows.via: Agent, USB serial (a port of PrusaLink)

rows.note: Tested against a simulated printer only.

rows.model: DYMO LabelMANAGER PC, LabelMANAGER PC II, LabelPoint 350, LabelManager 280
DYMO LabelManager 420P, LabelManager Wireless PnP, MobileLabeler

proof.how: labels printed from the hub, two side by side on an S0722530 roll

rows.note: Driven with the 450's PPD; their own (lw450t.ppd, lw450dl.ppd) is not in the agent yet (#230).
Its own PPD (lw400.ppd) and DYMO Connect's rolls for it; not tried on a printer yet.
Their own PPD data (DYMO Connect 1.6.4.18) is not in the agent yet (#230).

proof.how: a label printed from the hub on a 99012 roll

rows.note: Its place across the label is still open (#233).
DYMO's filter drives them with its base class, as the 320; their own PPD is not in the agent yet.

proof.how: homing, jogging, setting the origin and framing, with the laser off

rows.note: Nothing engraved yet; a job is only ever started by someone at the laser.
What was measured on the Ortur (grblHAL) is in #165.
